answer: Proposal: each ID/day relays 1 GiB of distinct encrypted trellis spiral-scan video and whisper audio to assigned receivers. A trusted registry checks receiver-signed ID/day/job byte receipts and rejects reuse; missing or invalid receipts deny listing. Receivers must be honest: collusion can fake delivery. Metered egress fees recur; routers are reusable capital; no stake. Cheap bandwidth weakens deterrence. Assuming incompressible ciphertext, ten IDs move 10 GiB even with shared links or parallel transfers.
